Stylish Seaside Santa Monica Luxury with Five Eateries & Lagoon Pool

Santa Monica, United States

Experience Santa Monica’s most storied coastal retreat, home to the region’s only private bungalows and a legacy of celebrity stays including Greta Garbo and Marilyn Monroe. Set atop the bluffs overlooking the golden beaches of Los Angeles, this 19th-century estate is a luxury hideaway placing you moments from the Santa Monica Pier and Third Street Promenade. Unwind by the palm-fringed pool or savor ocean-to-table flavors at FIG Restaurant. Sip handcrafted cocktails with sunset views at The Bungalow, or enjoy an intimate eight-seat sushi experience at Soko Sushi, which also offers meals to go. Stay refreshed with the onsite Em Styles Salon and Lloyd's Barbershop and a 24-hour fitness centre. Spanning five acres of lush gardens, embody laid-back luxury with effortless California cool.
